source: AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH) 2024-25 to 2026-27, supplied by the user (231 pages). Cross-checked against this validator on 2026-10-22.
note: This is an engineering cross-check by the build team, not legal advice or an official AICTE reading. Coverage reflects what the prototype actually does; 'Not covered' items are planned work.

items.requirement: All documents must be digitally signed (DSC) by the Chairman/Secretary; a document uploaded without a DSC is not valid.
items.validator: Signature validation (pyHanko, MOCK trust root) flags invalid / tampered / untrusted / expired signatures (R-SIG). Rule R-APH-DSC flags UNSIGNED documents but ships disabled because the synthetic corpus is mostly unsigned (enable in the checklist JSON).

items.requirement: Affidavit 2 on Rs.100 e-stamp paper, sworn before a First Class Judicial Magistrate / Notary / Oath Commissioner, digitally signed.
items.validator: Affidavit is a required document (presence, classification, issue date, duplicate and metadata checks). Stamp value, notary seal and sworn-before details are not extracted.

items.requirement: Copy of the fee payment receipt printed from the AICTE web portal.
Valid Occupancy / Completion Certificate / Building Licence / Form D from the competent authority.
items.validator: No document type yet; the expiry / authenticity / verification engine can be reused by adding a type and checklist rule.

items.requirement: Structural Stability Certificate from a registered structural engineer if the building is more than 30 years old.
Valid Fire Safety Certificate from the competent authority.
Satellite map showing the land with latitude / longitude at the main building entrance.
items.validator: Needs a vision model; planned (infrastructure-evidence capabilities #35-#36).

items.requirement: Audited statement of accounts of the Trust / Society / Company for the previous year.
No EoA once the live lease equals the longest course duration, unless the lease is extended by a further 30 years.
items.validator: Expired lease is flagged (R-EXP-LEASE, High). Rule R-APH-LEASE-TERM flags a lease with less than 4 years left; it ships disabled (the 4-year default is an assumption for a 4-year degree course).

items.requirement: Reduced compliance for land documents and NOC from the affiliating university / State; obtaining the NOC remains the institution's responsibility.
items.validator: The demo checklists still list NOC, lease and affiliation letter as required documents. Checklists are JSON, so they can be aligned to the current APH annexure without code changes.

items.requirement: 3-year EoA for institutions meeting criteria such as NBA accreditation (>=30% eligible courses), NAAC >= 3.01, NIRF / QS ranking, autonomy, >80% admissions.
items.validator: Accreditation certificate is a document type with expiry checks. The eligibility thresholds themselves are not evaluated.

items.requirement: Applications are processed strictly on uploaded documents by the Scrutiny / Re-Scrutiny Committee; institutions may submit compliance for deficiencies.
items.validator: Scrutiny queue with evidence, reviewer decisions (accept / override / request clarification) and replacement uploads with version history; decisions are carried over on re-run.

items.requirement: Fraudulent documents attract criminal action against the Director / Principal and Chairman / Secretary.
items.validator: Indicators (duplicate file hash, metadata dates, issuer-reference mismatch, signature and image-tamper indicators) are raised as ADVISORY findings for human review; none is treated as proof.

items.requirement: Applicant must submit a copy of the application to the State Government / UT and affiliating University and obtain a receipt.
A Letter of Approval is valid for two academic years; after that it stands cancelled.
items.validator: Previous EoA / approval letters are checked for expiry against the application submission date (R-EXP-PREVIOUS_EOA_LETTER).

items.requirement: Institutions are selected at random for Expert Visit Committee inspection.
items.validator: Inspection recommendation is a planned capability (#37).
